_comment: Hand-worked labels of the worker's synthetic samples (casting-worker/tools/make_samples.cpp), from the geometry alone: weight = volume x density (7100 kg/m3, gray iron), cores = closed cavities, minimum wall = the thinnest section, draw axis = the shallowest direction (or the one with the least hidden material). A development check of the gate's tooling: a synthetic corpus can never pass the real-part gate (S3).
